claim_boundary.source: offline replay of retained native hazards and roots
claim_boundary.substitution: proposal-only replacement of every local hazard query inside the existing planner; recurrence, beam, root, and action selection are unchanged
claim_boundary.authority: differential parity and performance evidence only; the default live controller does not call this export
claim_boundary.float_tolerance: hard clearances <= 1e-4; soft risk/score differences are reported without granting action authority

sample.method: bounded union of Boolean-losing, 240-frame pre-hit, and full action-eligible roots
